tools.description: Start here to turn a drug or compound name into a ChEMBL ID for get_molecule, drug_indications or list_activities. Salts are separate molecules (imatinib CHEMBL941, imatinib mesylate CHEMBL1642) sharing parent_chembl_id.
What a drug is approved or in trials for. Pass any form (parent or salt); the result covers the parent family.
Read a compound or drug once you have its ChEMBL ID (from search_molecules) or an InChIKey from another database. Mechanism target_chembl_id values feed get_target and list_activities.
